subject: Deploy Candidate 01 original Codrops 8:5 focus restore
body: Deploy Candidate 01 branch SHA 503da7702f2637d5eb2165441e9b760d53b21fd5 to the local Doré Design resident. This supersedes all Candidate 01 mosaic/four-crop deployment requests. Required visible behavior: preserve the verified GridToFullPreview interaction from dore-design/codrops_site_8x5.py exactly; only the card orientation/proportion is horizontal 8:5. Hover remains 100ms; selected card triggers the original preview reveal/cross-mask motion; leaving reverses the same motion. Do not install living-current drift, dore-mosaic-layer, dore-mosaic-piece, assemble/release state machines, or extra hover-reader behavior. products__preview must remain visible on desktop. Do not alter public homepage.

argv: HTML=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate-01-codrops-8x5-embed' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'GridToFullPreview 8:5' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'dore-mosaic-layer' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate-01-living-editorial-runtime'
